name: API Integration
description: Use a web API well with HTTP Request: read its documentation, start with a cheap read, page through results, handle sign-in errors and rate limits, and ask before every change.
abilities: Checks the API's documentation before the first call
Pages through results by link, cursor or page number until it has what you asked for
Tells a wrong sign-in from a missing permission, and waits out rate limits
Shows exactly what a change will send before asking you to approve it
permissions: Uses HTTP Request and the connections you saved; Web Search and Web Page Reader for documentation
